data.final_table_comment: Final feature table built by final_features from 2 feature-selection run(s) sharing target='uphold_5pct_5day' and setup [lookback_d=10, horizon_h=5, normalize=none, feature_normalize=cs_rank, corr_threshold=0.9, n_splits=5, min_train=500, random_state=18, selector_class=CrossSectionalSelector, methods=permutation, spearman, xgb_shap, design_dtype=float64, env_fingerprint=cf51e65b3a15]. Shortlist fingerprint: 7f5408240792 over 157 channels. 157 channels from 2 pool(s). Selection layer 1: ⚠️ a UNION of per-pool runs, NOT a consensus - a channel offered to one run could never be a candidate in another, so agreement was not available to measure (.claude/context/final_features.md section 6). Run evidence: cleared_p95_not_a_pass=2. ⚠️ UNIVERSE: restricted to the 228 names the selection ranked across, and the label is a rank WITHIN them — AAA, ABB, ACB, ACV, ANV, APH, ASM, BAF, … (sha1 335362d964). ⚠️ CHANNELS=ALL: every numeric channel of each pool whose selection run is in the plan - the selection decided WHICH POOLS, not the width inside one. Source runs: 2026-09-19_135823__liquid__event_features__uphold_5pct_5day; 2026-09-19_165103__liquid__basic__uphold_5pct_5day

split.purge_rule: lookback + label span - 1 (feature_selection.PurgedWalkForward; the span is h, or h + 1 for an `open`-rule event label)

loss.rule: binary cross-entropy on the 0/1 event label, unweighted, no class weighting
loss.chosen_because: the decision has two halves and both were measured: 84 % of the edge is choosing the NAME inside a session (a rank) and 16 % is choosing the SESSION through the min_prob cut (a LEVEL). Log-loss is a proper scoring rule, so one number serves both; rank:pairwise is invariant to monotone transforms inside a query, so its scores cannot be compared across sessions and the cut is lost.
loss.would_flip_if: the cut is dropped and a fixed basket is traded every session
loss.early_stopping: val log-loss. ⚠️ VAL NOW CHOOSES THE MODEL, THE CUT AND THE ROUND, so val_daily_auc is a selection score and TEST is the only honest read. The refit paths have no val and reuse the frozen fit's round.
loss.families_that_cannot_stop: a forest is one boosting round, a logistic is convex (capacity is C/alpha), and the prior does not fit — they write a one-row loss_history.csv

basket.best_rule: max val_daily_auc (the other val metrics break a tie), excluding BASELINE_PRIOR
basket.entry_screen: none: a name at its ceiling on N is bought
basket.min_prob_rule: max val ev over 51 cuts, >= 25 active val sessions

report_config.best_rule: max VAL ROC-AUC, excluding BASELINE_PRIOR and BLEND (a FIXED ensemble is eligible)
report_config.refit_rule: the run's own config refitted on train+val, test scored once
report_config.rolling_rule: refitted every 21 test sessions on all rows ending d+h-1 samples before the block; blocks pooled
report_config.threshold_rule: VAL threshold maximising F1, applied once to TEST
